items.title: Jev: New frontier model 40-400x cheaper and 20-200x faster
items.summary: Typesafe.ai has introduced a new frontier model named Jev that significantly reduces costs and increases processing speeds, making it a game-changer for AI developers. This advancement could democratize access to powerful AI tools and enhance performance in various applications.

items.title: Show HN: Capsule – Single-file web apps that save their data into SQLite
items.summary: Capsule introduces a novel approach to web app development by allowing single-file applications to store their data in SQLite, simplifying deployment and data management. This innovation could streamline the development process for web engineers looking for lightweight solutions.

items.title: We got admin access to Baseten's production GitHub in 25 minutes
items.summary: A security analysis revealed that Baseten's production GitHub was compromised in just 25 minutes, highlighting critical vulnerabilities in access management. This incident serves as a stark reminder for developers to prioritize security measures in their workflows.

items.title: Gemini 3.8 Live and 3.8 Live Extended Thinking
items.summary: Google has launched Gemini 3.8 Live, enhancing its AI capabilities with extended thinking features that improve contextual understanding and response generation. This update is crucial for developers working on applications that require advanced AI interactions.

items.title: An Update on Wayback Machine Access
items.summary: The Internet Archive has provided an important update on access to the Wayback Machine, ensuring that developers and researchers can continue to utilize this vital resource for web history. This enhancement supports the preservation of digital content and aids in research efforts.
